sentences.text: ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Ashok Bishnoi.

For Respondent(s) : Mr. Urja Ram Kalbi, PP.
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 18/12/2025

This application for bail under Section 483 of BNSS has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.158/2023 registered at Police Station Seruna, District Bikaner, for offences under Sections 304B and 498A IPC and in the alternative Section 302 IPC.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the marriage of the petitioner was solemnized with the deceased on 25.06.2018.

The deceased Suman, within a period of five years of her marriage,
committed suicide while jumping into a water tank.

In the FIR lodged by the father of the deceased,
it is alleged that the petitioner and his family members used to harass and humiliate the deceased in connection with dowry demand.
Learned (Uploaded on 19/12/2025 at 11:58:02 AM)
[CRLMB-14334/2025] counsel submitted that the allegation of dowry demand levelled against the petitioner and his family members is absolutely false and incorrect.

It was contended that though in the FIR, allegation of dowry demand was levelled against the petitioner and other family members but the police, after making thorough investigation in the Shrawan Ram vs State Of Rajasthan (2025:Rj-Jd:55126) on 18 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/93167903/
1 matter, has filed charge-sheet against the petitioner only and thus, it is proved that the complainant has not made correct statement of dowry demand in the FIR.

sentences.text: Learned counsel submitted that the statement of the complainant have already been recorded before the competent criminal court; the petitioner is in judicial custody since 15.11.2023 and the trial of the case is likely to consume sufficiently long time.
On these grounds, he implored the Court to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application and submitted that in the present case, a young girl, within five years of her marriage, jumped into a water tank in her matrimonial house and therefore, looking to the seriousness of allegation against the petitioner, he does not deserves to be enlarged on bail.

However, he was not in a position to refute the fact that the statements of the complainant have already been recorded before the competent criminal court and there is no apprehension of the petitioner influencing other material prosecution witnesses or fleeing away from justice in case he is in enlarged on bail.

Having considered the rival submissions, facts and circumstances of the case, this Court prima facie finds that that (Uploaded on 19/12/2025 at 11:58:02 AM) [2025:RJ-JD:55126] (3 of 3)
[CRLMB-14334/2025] statements of the complainant have already been recorded before the competent criminal court.

In the opinion of this Court, the question as to whether the deceased committed suicide due to harassment and humiliation caused to her or for any other reason, would be decided by the trial court while appreciating the evidence.

This Court, however, in view of the fact that statements of the complainant have already been recorded before the competent criminal and as the learned Public Prosecutor has not shown any apprehension of the petitioner influencing the remaining prosecution witnesses or fleeing away from justice in case he is enlarged on bail, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Consequently, the bail application under Section 483 of BNSS is allowed.

It is ordered that the accused-petitioner Shrawan Ram S/o Shri Uda Ram arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.158/2023 registered at Police Station Seruna, District Bikaner, shall be released on bail, if not wanted in any other case, provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/-
each, to the satisfaction of learned trial court, for his appearance before that court on each & every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till completion of the trial.
It is however, made clear that findings recorded/observations made above are for limited purposes of adjudication of bail application.
The trial court shall not get prejudiced by the same.

(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 646-Tikam/-
